name: Granola
description: AI meeting notes — pull your summarized notes and full transcripts. Requires a Business-plan API key (grn_...).

methods.label: List Notes
methods.description: List meeting notes that have a generated AI summary. Supports pagination. Returns a list of notes (id, title, summary, date). Notes without a summary are excluded.

methods.label: Get Note
methods.description: Get a single note by id. Pass include='transcript' to also return the full transcript. Returns the note detail (summary, attendees, optionally transcript).

include.description: Set to 'transcript' to include the full transcript
